# Reference

Every page here is **generated from the source** by `cargo run --bin organon -- docs`, and a test fails the build if a checked-in page drifts from the code. Fix a description by editing the Rust, not the Markdown.

| Page | What it covers | Source of truth |
|---|---|---|
| [Generators](generators.md) | the geometry engines — what each one makes | `agent.rs::generator_desc` |
| [Surfaces](surfaces.md) | how a generator's nodes become geometry | `agent.rs::surface_desc` |
| [Materials](materials.md) | how that geometry is shaded | `agent.rs::material_desc` |
| [Parameters](parameters.md) | every CLI-settable control, with ranges | `agent.rs::param_desc` |
| [Recipes](recipes.md) | built-in starting-points | `recipe.rs` |

For the narrative version — what to *do* with these — start at [the guide](../guide/README.md).

The `organon` CLI serves this same material from the same source, so the two cannot disagree; it is simply closer to hand when you are already at a terminal, and it works whether or not Organon is running:

```bash
organon catalog --manual     # all of it, in the terminal
organon describe dna         # one entry in depth
```
